comparison.objective: Install a spring-pin breaker lockout and padlock on a named miniature circuit breaker.
comparison.physical_skill: Two-handed lockout placement, spring-pin engagement, and padlock manipulation; no controlled fracture or loose-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Lockout and padlock installed; detailed scoring tolerances are absent from the record.
comparison.reason: It tests constrained locking and latching, whereas the candidate tests coaxial mandrel placement, impact-driven notch fracture, retained-coil protection, and recovery of four fragments.
